extraction.notes: Three-month column 12/31/2022 used. No AFFO metric is reported, so AFFO fields are null. Core FFO is the company's adjusted FFO measure. The FFO and Core FFO subtotals shown are before the Series D preferred dividend add-back; the diluted totals (FFO 21,438; Core FFO 21,643) add 160 back and are divided by 18,423 diluted shares and units, which reproduces $1.16 and $1.17. Zero-amount lines (loss on extinguishment of debt, commercial lease termination proceeds, acquisition related costs) are printed as dashes for the quarter and recorded as 0. 'Technology implementation costs' is a two-year implementation cost and was categorized as 'other'. Recurring capex: the document shows only 'Total Capital Expenditures per Apartment Home - Same-Store' of $364 for the quarter, which is per unit only and not a dollar total, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. The 'Adjusted EBITDA' reconciliation on seq 16 was not used.
